findings.title: wrangler depends on sharp <0.35.4 (high severity, GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c)
findings.detail: wrangler@^4.123.0 → miniflare → sharp <0.35.4 contains heap-buffer-overflow vulnerabilities in libheif (GHSA-g89c-p67h-r497, GHSA-2jg2-4ch7-h545). Affects node_modules/sharp, node_modules/miniflare, node_modules/wrangler. Fix is available via npm audit fix (bumps wrangler to 4.131.0+ which pulls in sharp >=0.35.4).
findings.suggested_fix: Run npm audit fix to update wrangler to >=4.131.0, pulling in sharp >=0.35.4

findings.title: react and react-dom are one major version behind (18.x vs 19.x latest)
findings.detail: react@18.3.1 and react-dom@18.3.1 are pinned; react@19.3.0 is the current latest major. React 19 includes breaking changes (Actions API, new hooks) that would require a migration review.
findings.suggested_fix: Evaluate React 19 migration guide; update package.json to use react@^19.0.0 and react-dom@^19.0.0 after reviewing breaking changes

findings.title: src/shared/urlFilter.ts modified recently with no test file
findings.detail: src/shared/urlFilter.ts was modified within the last 14 days but has no sibling test file (urlFilter.test.ts). The other shared modules (lazyPoster, letterboxdUrl, posters, tmdb) all have test coverage.
findings.suggested_fix: Add src/shared/urlFilter.test.ts covering buildPageUrl round-trips, describeFilter output, and isProxyBlockedFilter detection

findings.title: src/popup/Popup.tsx has no test file
findings.detail: src/popup/Popup.tsx was modified recently and is the extension's primary UI component, but there is no Popup.test.tsx. Testing React components in jsdom is feasible with @testing-library/react.
findings.suggested_fix: Add src/popup/Popup.test.tsx with smoke tests for card type selection and generate button state
